referenceFunction.generalComment: Disposal of a ventilation unit (air handling unit) with 13000 m3/h nominal air flow rate (at 2 m/s air speed in cross section of air filter or heat exchanger), component weight: 2915 kg, total weight: 3307 kg/Unit, including average components for controls, inverter and electric control cabinet, material for 20 filter replacements (once a year for 20 years lifetime). The air handling unit includes a frame construction, two radial belt drive fans, two multi-leaf damper, heat recovery with aluminium rotary heat exchanger (thermal wheel), heating elements, expansion plenum and empty section in supply and extract air. No cooling elements, humidifier, air-mixing plenum and silencer included. The frame construction made of aluminium-profiles, casing made of hot-dip galvanized and powder coated steel sheets insulated with polyurethane foam.; UUID: 9fb343bb-b9a7-4cd7-9bad-4993cac00cdd
